name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
A new Today home: the first thing you see each morning is your day - money that came in, who to chase (biggest first, with how reliably each one pays), how much cash is likely this week, and how many days your money is stuck on average.
ASVA now knows your trade: pick your line (electricals, chemicals, hardware and more) once in setup, and customers with no credit period in Tally get sensible due dates automatically - electricals starts at 60 days. A real Tally credit period always still wins.
Fairer reliability: a customer is rated only on their own record with you, and one late bill among many paid on time no longer drags their score down.
Money-in alert: the moment a customer says they paid, your computer shows a notification so you never miss it.
Your WhatsApp stays connected through updates: ASVA keeps a safe copy of your login so an update never quietly logs you out.
Ask a customer to confirm their balance in one tap from their page (at most once every 90 days, only when you press it).
